# USAboundariesData

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ropensci/USAboundariesData/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/USAboundariesData/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

## Overview

This R package contains datasets for the
[USAboundaries](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundaries/) package.
Please see that package for documentation and installation instructions.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`USAboundariesData`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/USAboundariesData.md)
  : USAboundariesData
- [`ahcb_boundaries`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/ahcb_boundaries.md)

  [`counties_historical_lores`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/ahcb_boundaries.md)

  America

  [`congress_contemporary_lores`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/census_boundaries.md)
  [`counties_contemporary_hires`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/census_boundaries.md)
  [`counties_contemporary_lores`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/census_boundaries.md)
  [`states_contemporary_hires`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/census_boundaries.md)
  [`states_contemporary_lores`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/census_boundaries.md)
  [`zipcodes`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/census_boundaries.md)
  : Cartographic boundary files from the U.S. Census Bureau
- [`census_cities`](https://docs.ropensci.org/USAboundariesData/reference/census_cities.md)
